title.zh: 博通正设法为OpenAI所需的芯片安排超过500亿美元融资
title.en: 博通正设法为OpenAI所需的芯片安排超过500亿美元融资

current_state.zh: Broadcom is seeking to arrange more than $50 billion in financing for chips required by OpenAI, while Oracle negotiates chip financing with Apollo and Goldman Sachs and SpaceX pursues roughly $40 billion to fund Nvidia chip purchases.
current_state.en: Broadcom is seeking to arrange more than $50 billion in financing for chips required by OpenAI, while Oracle negotiates chip financing with Apollo and Goldman Sachs and SpaceX pursues roughly $40 billion to fund Nvidia chip purchases.
